expectations.text: Shows ledger changes as was → now with the source
expectations.evidence: Table with columns 'Object | Was | Now | Source', five rows each sourced to 'Loan officer, 2026-11-19' or 'LOI per you, against the lender's 75 days'.
No debt terms, price, rate or date supplied. Only non-record items are the 'Was' cells ('NOT VERIFIED (not checked)'), which assume a prior ledger state but feed no finding, cure or number.

Stage held below commitment: 'VERIFIED at preliminary credit approval, with appraisal outstanding. This is not a commitment.' Seller remark: 'NOT VERIFIED (not checked): the lender relayed it, and the seller owns this fact'. Lender facts marked verified only as 'stated by the lender about its own position'; 'Nothing is in writing yet.'
No call script or words-to-be-spoken appear anywhere in the response.

Says 'closing on the stated date will not happen under the current LOI terms with this financing' (a timing finding, not a statement of which provision controls) and flags 'calendar or business days. The day count is for counsel to confirm' and 'how to paper it, is for the parties and counsel.'
No advice to either side: 'Whether to adopt it, and how to paper it, is for the parties and counsel.' No value, price or negotiating move.
Cure is the exact verified figure: 'closing 75 days from the signed PSA, with every other stated term unchanged... The seller's reported flexibility plays no part in it.' No cushion.

format_checks.evidence: First line: 'the stated closing is 15 days short'.
'Whether the appraisal has been ordered, when it is due, and whether the 75 days already includes it. The lender can answer' (one topic, three parts).
Every ledger row carries VERIFIED / NOT VERIFIED (not checked / does not hold); open entries counted as unknown: '3 verified, 2 not verified..., 9 unknown'.
Ends with 'Work record: Evidence checked: loan officer's statements as you relayed them, with no documents seen | Calculations run: closing difference...'
60/75/15 appear in Finding, Said, Ledger updates, Alignment re-run, Discovery and Cure.

Several open entries name the fact but not what it lets the parties decide: '1031 exchange: not asked of either party.'; 'Seller's timing: only the seller or its authorized representative can state it.' Others do ('This shows whether 75 days is the whole requirement').

notes: Clean on all critical codes. 'Was' column asserts a prior ledger state that is not in the record, and the alignment expression is written '60 − 75 = 15'; neither changes a finding.
